summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (placed after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions; correctness was checked by reading only. One known caveat: forward does not cast the target to long, so non-int64 integer targets will fail in F.one_hot / gather, as the spec's no-validation rule implies.
